scope: Independent narrow review of the provenance-only correction for the two new Phase V browser probes. Existing UX/editor behavior, evidence assertions and browser timing policy are unchanged.
sourceFindings: The 17-line shared helper resolves the physical checkout root from its own module URL, checks that the adjacent .git marker is a file or directory, and sets cwd to that root.

Each read subprocess receives an explicit argument-vector Git -c safe.directory=<resolved exact root>; there is no shell interpolation, wildcard trust, git config write or environment-derived provenance fallback.
The helper reads actual HEAD, HEAD^{tree} and tracked status. It retains trackedTreeClean=false for real tracked edits and excludes untracked observation output as before.
Editor evidence continues to keep actual checkout SHA/tree separate from PR sourceHead/base metadata. UX evidence now also includes trackedTreeClean.
The complete commit changes only the shared helper and its two consumers. Existing assertions, screenshots, font waiting, observation sample/action counts, deadlines and test selection are unchanged.

ownershipAndProvenance.mode: Real Git and exact helper bytes with GIT_TEST_ASSUME_DIFFERENT_OWNER=1, empty reviewer-owned global config and no system config; no chmod/chown or browser execution.

independentValidation.configWrites: No author, system or real global Git config changes. The ownership test used only its own empty config and verified both that file and its synthetic repository config were unchanged by the helper.

primarySource.supports: safe.directory is an explicit exception for a directory with different ownership, honored in protected configuration including command scope. Wildcard * disables the broad check; this helper does not use it.

limitations: The ownership boundary was exercised using real Git with GIT_TEST_ASSUME_DIFFERENT_OWNER=1; this is a controlled ownership-check reproduction, not a new hosted Playwright container run.
